$comment: Base permission profile for `engine drive` children, passed to `claude -p` with --settings next to --permission-mode dontAsk and --setting-sources project, so anything not allowed here is denied rather than prompted. drive adds the engine path prefix, the implement-only git add/commit, and the repo's declared verify command. Never a bypass mode and never a blanket Bash grant: drive refuses to start on a profile that has either (--profile <file> replaces this one and is checked the same way).
